scientific_question: Do original BassDI EME missed by the frozen htdemucs_ft-to-JGA correspondence retain signal-grounded pitched/harmonic evidence in the controlled full mix compatible with an independently estimated BassDI pitch?

candidate_stage_inputs: frozen original EME timestamps and IDs solely as observation locations
frozen recovered/missed and Kick labels solely as labels
ground_truth_firewall.stage_lock: candidate_outputs.json is SHA-256 hashed and locally committed before the evaluation program may read BassDI

f0_search.register: sounding E1 through G3; broad plausible Double Bass fundamental register
f0_search.local_noise_reference: median power from +/-100 to +/-200 cents around each harmonic, excluding +/-35 cents
f0_search.frame_harmonic_score: mean of the four largest log1p(harmonic_power/local_noise) values among available partials
f0_search.missing_fundamental: permitted; a frame requires at least 3 supported partials but does not require harmonic 1
f0_search.top_candidate_set: up to 3 local F0-score maxima at least 35 cents apart and at least 95% of the best aggregate score

evidence_decision.frame_eligible: at least 3 supported partials and harmonic-to-total spectral energy ratio at least 0.12
evidence_decision.track_stability: at least 3 consecutive eligible frames whose best F0 values span no more than 35 cents
evidence_decision.present: stable run exists and at least half of available frames are eligible

note_mapping.nearest_note: nearest integer MIDI, ties toward lower integer

independent_bassdi_evaluation.timing_and_frontend: identical fixed windows/frontend/F0 grid and signal method applied independently to BassDI only after candidate lock
independent_bassdi_evaluation.reference_evaluable: BassDI yields PITCHED_EVIDENCE_PRESENT with a stable candidate set
independent_bassdi_evaluation.agreement: minimum absolute cents between any frozen mix candidate and any BassDI reference candidate <= 50 cents; octave differences are not collapsed
independent_bassdi_evaluation.limitation: BassDI is an isolated microphone observation and estimator-derived pitch proxy, not symbolic note or physical-onset Ground Truth

metrics.primary: compatible frozen mix evidence / BassDI-evaluable MISSED_BASS
additional: pitch-error median, quartiles and RMSE for compatible events

classification_gates.STRONG: all replay/authority/firewall invariants pass; at least 80% of MISSED_BASS are BassDI-evaluable; compatible proportion among evaluable MISSED_BASS >=0.50 and Wilson lower bound >=0.40
classification_gates.PARTIAL: all invariants pass; at least 80% evaluability; compatible proportion >=0.20 and Wilson lower bound >=0.10, without meeting STRONG
classification_gates.INSUFFICIENT: all invariants pass and evaluability >=80%, but PARTIAL is not met
classification_gates.INDETERMINATE: any authority/firewall/replay invariant fails or MISSED_BASS BassDI evaluability is below 80%

replay.requirement: canonical JSON byte identity within each stage

interpretation_firewall: Explanatory association only. No physical-onset Ground Truth, complete transcription, causal masking, groove/swing interpretation, production readiness, or recovery implementation claim.

software.environment: temporary venv outside JGA with system-site-packages referencing the unchanged frozen JGA environment
